Topics.Description: Table: Topics. A broad domain in which AI-handling strategies are being compared -- e.g. 'AI in Education' or 'AI Regulation Approaches'. New topics can be added freely as the project's scope grows.

schema.name: TopicId
schema.Description: Stored identifier for the topic. Slug form, e.g. 'ai-in-education'.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Display alias for the topic.

schema.name: Title
schema.Description: Short human-readable title of the topic, e.g. 'AI in Education'.

schema.name: Icon
schema.Description: A single emoji representing this topic, used as a visual anchor in the UI.

schema.name: Summary
schema.Description: One or two sentence summary of what this topic covers.

schema.name: Strategies
schema.Description: Strategies (specific approaches) explored within this topic.

schema.name: CountOfStrategies
schema.Description: Total number of strategies recorded under this topic.

Criteria.Description: Table: Criteria. A shared grading dimension used to score every strategy across every topic on the same scale (1-5), so strategies can be directly compared even when they come from very different domains -- e.g. comparing an education strategy against a regulation strategy on 'Cost'.

schema.name: CriterionId
schema.Description: Stored identifier for the criterion. Slug form, e.g. 'cost'.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Display alias for the criterion.

schema.name: Title
schema.Description: Short human-readable title of the criterion, e.g. 'Cost & Resource Burden'.

schema.name: Icon
schema.Description: A single emoji representing this criterion, used as a visual anchor in the UI.

schema.name: Description
schema.Description: What this criterion measures and how to interpret a high vs. low score.

schema.name: HighScoreMeaning
schema.Description: Short phrase describing what a score of 5 means for this criterion, e.g. 'Low cost, minimal resources needed'.

schema.name: LowScoreMeaning
schema.Description: Short phrase describing what a score of 1 means for this criterion, e.g. 'Very expensive, major resource burden'.

schema.name: SortOrder
schema.Description: Display order for this criterion relative to other criteria, ascending.

schema.name: Scores
schema.Description: Every strategy score recorded against this criterion.

schema.name: CountOfScores
schema.Description: Total number of strategies scored against this criterion.

schema.name: AverageScore
schema.Description: Average score (1-5) across every strategy graded against this criterion, showing how favorably strategies tend to score on this dimension overall.

Strategies.Description: Table: Strategies. A distinct approach for handling AI within a topic -- e.g. 'Essay Writing vs. AI-Assisted Exploration' or 'Licensing & Mandatory Audits'. New strategies can be added freely as a topic's scope grows.

schema.name: StrategyId
schema.Description: Stored identifier for the strategy. Slug form, e.g. 'essay-vs-ai-conversation'.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Display alias for the strategy.

schema.name: Topic
schema.Description: The topic this strategy belongs to.

schema.name: TopicTitle
schema.Description: Title of the parent topic.

schema.name: TopicIcon
schema.Description: Icon of the parent topic.

schema.name: Title
schema.Description: Short human-readable title of the strategy, e.g. 'Essay Writing vs. AI-Assisted Exploration'.

schema.name: Summary
schema.Description: One or two sentence summary of what this strategy examines.

schema.name: Verdict
schema.Description: Synthesis judgment on when this strategy actually makes sense and when to avoid it, weighing the tradeoffs above.

schema.name: RecommendedFor
schema.Description: Short phrase naming the specific context or actor this strategy is best suited for.

schema.name: MaturityLevel
schema.Description: How proven this strategy is in real-world practice today: 'Experimental', 'Emerging', or 'Proven'.

schema.name: PrimaryTag
schema.Description: A single short filterable label for this strategy's core mechanism, e.g. 'Assessment Redesign', 'Technical Control', 'Curriculum'.

schema.name: Scenarios
schema.Description: Example scenarios that illustrate this strategy in practice.

schema.name: Considerations
schema.Description: Individual pros and cons recorded against this strategy.

schema.name: Scores
schema.Description: Scores recorded for this strategy against each shared criterion.

schema.name: CountOfConsiderations
schema.Description: Total number of pros and cons recorded for this strategy.

schema.name: CountOfPros
schema.Description: Number of pro considerations recorded for this strategy.

schema.name: CountOfCons
schema.Description: Number of con considerations recorded for this strategy.

schema.name: AverageScore
schema.Description: Average score (1-5) across all criteria this strategy has been graded on -- the single-number summary stat for cross-strategy comparison.

Scenarios.Description: Table: Scenarios. A concrete example that illustrates how a strategy plays out in practice.

schema.name: ScenarioId
schema.Description: Stored identifier for the scenario. Slug form.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Display alias for the scenario.

schema.name: Strategy
schema.Description: The strategy this scenario illustrates.

schema.name: StrategyTitle
schema.Description: Title of the parent strategy.

schema.name: Title
schema.Description: Short title of the scenario.

schema.name: Description
schema.Description: Full description of how the scenario plays out.

Considerations.Description: Table: Considerations. A single pro or con recorded against a strategy, optionally tied to the shared Criterion it provides evidence for.

schema.name: ConsiderationId
schema.Description: Stored identifier for the consideration. Slug form.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Display alias for the consideration.

schema.name: Strategy
schema.Description: The strategy this consideration belongs to.

schema.name: StrategyTitle
schema.Description: Title of the parent strategy.

schema.name: Criterion
schema.Description: The shared criterion this pro or con is evidence for, if any.

schema.name: CriterionTitle
schema.Description: Title of the related criterion.

schema.name: IsPro
schema.Description: TRUE if this consideration is a pro (benefit); FALSE if it is a con (drawback).

schema.name: Statement
schema.Description: The pro or con itself, stated in a sentence.

schema.name: Kind
schema.Description: Human-readable label for whether this is a pro or a con.

StrategyScores.Description: Table: StrategyScores. A single numeric score (1-5) recording how a strategy performs against one shared criterion, with a short rationale. This is the join table that makes strategies comparable on the same stats across topics -- e.g. comparing an education strategy's Cost score directly against a regulation strategy's Cost score.

schema.name: ScoreId
schema.Description: Stored identifier for the score. Slug form, e.g. 'ai-proctored-open-exams__cost'.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Display alias for the score.

schema.name: Strategy
schema.Description: The strategy being scored.

schema.name: StrategyTitle
schema.Description: Title of the scored strategy.

schema.name: Criterion
schema.Description: The shared criterion being scored against.

schema.name: CriterionTitle
schema.Description: Title of the criterion.

schema.name: CriterionIcon
schema.Description: Icon of the criterion.

schema.name: Score
schema.Description: Score from 1 (very unfavorable on this criterion) to 5 (very favorable).

schema.name: Rationale
schema.Description: One-sentence rationale for why this strategy earned this score on this criterion.
